scholarships.title: Scholarships of the Government of the Czech Republic for Students from Developing Countries
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MŠMT) / Dům zahraniční spolupráce (DZS)

existing.description: Scholarships of the Government of the Czech Republic for students from developing countries let nationals of designated partner states study at Czech public universities within the Czech foreign development cooperation programme. DZS states that "the Czech Republic offers scholarships to foreigners for a standard period of study in accredited university study programmes provided at public universities, and for courses in the Czech language and vocational preparation". Awards cover a master's study programme in Czech preceded by a one-year Czech language and professional training course, or study in master's and doctoral study programmes conducted in English. Applications are made through an electronic form, then the file passes through the applicant's Czech embassy, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and MŠMT.
eligibility: Be a national of one of the states listed in the current annual call
Not hold permanent residence in the Czech Republic
Not be a citizen of the Czech Republic or of the European Union
Meet the conditions set out in the Guidelines for Granting Scholarships of the Government of the Czech Republic
For English-language study: advanced knowledge of English plus a pass in the online entrance English test
For Czech-language study: Czech language command at least at CEFR B2 level (exempts the applicant from the one-year preparatory course)
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to foreigners without permanent residence in the Czech Republic who are nationals of one of the states that receive Czech foreign development aid and who meet the conditions in the Guidelines for Granting Scholarships of the Government of the Czech Republic. Czech citizens, EU citizens and other foreign nationals holding a permanent residence permit in the Czech Republic may not apply, and there is no legal entitlement to the award.
benefits: Standard period of study in an accredited study programme at a Czech public university
One-year Czech language and professional training course where the Czech-language master's route requires it
coverage: Standard period of study in an accredited study programme at a Czech public university
One-year Czech language and professional training course where the Czech-language master's route requires it
requirements: Submit the electronic application form at the DZS application register by 30 September
Sit the required online test(s) after sending the application and before the register closes
Attend an interview at the Czech embassy responsible for the country whose citizens were offered scholarships
Submit the complete documentation requested by the embassy so that the file reaches the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and MŠMT by the stated date
Meet the admission requirements of the chosen accredited study programme at the Czech public university
documents: Documents of any started, passed and unfinished studies
List of study or research stays abroad for the last 5 years (year, length, place, purpose)
Online test(s): for Czech study, Test of General Academic Prerequisites; for English study, Test of English language plus Test of General Academic Prerequisites
existing.english_requirement: Advanced knowledge of English, demonstrated by passing an online entrance English test, for scholarships for study in English-language programmes
application_method: Prepare the basic materials (passport, study documents, list of stays abroad, motivation letter)
Create a personal email address to log in to the application register
Complete and send the electronic application form
Respond to the Czech embassy invitation and submit the requested documentation
existing.selection_notes: Successful candidates are invited to submit complete documentation by the embassy deadline; the most successful candidates are then proposed to MŠMT through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. There is no legal right to the scholarship.
existing.best_fit: Nationals of the designated partner states who hold an offer-worthy academic record and are prepared to study in Czech or in an English-language postgraduate programme at a Czech public university.
existing.application_period: Annual call. 2027/2028 cycle: applications open from 21 August 2026, electronic application form due 30 September 2026, supporting documents due 15 January 2027. Applications for the following annual cycle had not been announced on the official pages read.
existing.deadline_display: Official wording from DZS: "Each candidate is required to submit an electronic application form no later than 30 September." For the 2027/2028 academic year applications opened on 21 August 2026 and the electronic-form deadline was 30 September 2026, which has already passed as of 2026-10-04.
existing.program_type: Government bilateral scholarship under the Czech foreign development cooperation programme
